info.title: Jummall API
info.description: API documentation for authentication, buyer onboarding, seller operations, and admin management.

post.description: Authenticates a buyer, seller, or admin and returns an access token plus a revocable refresh token. If the credentials are valid but the account is still not verified, the request is rejected and a verification code is re-sent to the user's email.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and a rotated refresh token. Frontend should replace both tokens with the returned pair.
Starts the forgot-password flow. This endpoint intentionally returns a generic success response even when the email does not exist, so frontend should not expect account-existence feedback here.

example.message: If an account with that email exists, a password reset code has been sent.

post.summary: Verify a user's email with a code
post.description: Confirms the verification code sent to the user's email and updates the user account status to `verified`.

409.description: Account already verified

post.description: Re-issues an email verification code when the resend cooldown has passed. Any previously active verification code is invalidated.

409.description: Account already verified

post.description: Completes the password reset flow using the reset code sent by email.
Revokes the current authenticated session so the current refresh token can no longer be used. Frontend should still clear any locally stored tokens after this call.
Creates a reusable product category for the marketplace. Sellers later fetch and reference these categories when creating products.

409.description: Product category name already exists

get.description: Returns all product categories currently available in the admin-managed catalog.
Returns the current global shipping settings that govern the marketplace shipping engine, including the active ownership mode, category shipping mode, and vendor fallback policy.

patch.description: Updates one or more of the marketplace-wide shipping foundation settings. These values later determine whether platform or vendor shipping rules are used, how category fees are combined, and what happens when vendor shipping rules are missing.

post.description: Creates an admin-managed free shipping rule. Use the coupon variant when free shipping should be unlocked by a code, or use the threshold variant when free shipping should apply automatically after a discounted order subtotal is reached. Threshold requests must send `minimum_order_subtotal` and must not send `coupon_code`. Only one active threshold rule can exist at a time.

threshold_rule.description: Free shipping applies automatically once the discounted order subtotal reaches 50000.

409.description: Coupon code already exists or an active threshold rule already exists

get.description: Returns all admin-managed free shipping rules, including both coupon and threshold rules.
Returns one admin-managed free shipping rule by id.

patch.description: Updates an existing free shipping rule. You can change its name, type, coupon code, or threshold amount. Active threshold uniqueness is still enforced.

409.description: Coupon code already exists or an active threshold rule already exists

post.description: Activates a free shipping rule. Only one threshold free shipping rule can be active at a time.

409.description: Another active threshold free shipping rule already exists

post.description: Deactivates a free shipping rule without deleting it.
Creates a platform-owned shipping zone with one or more covered states and optional city-level targeting.

409.description: Shipping zone name already exists

get.description: Returns all platform-owned shipping zones configured by admins.
Returns a single platform-owned shipping zone with its state and city coverage.

patch.description: Updates a platform-owned shipping zone name and/or replaces its full state and city coverage.

409.description: Shipping zone name already exists

post.description: Marks a platform-owned shipping zone as active so it can be used by the shipping engine.
Marks a platform-owned shipping zone as inactive without deleting it.
Creates the platform shipping rule for a platform-owned zone. Only one platform zone rule can exist per zone.

409.description: Platform shipping zone rule already exists for this zone

get.description: Returns all platform-owned shipping zone rules.
Returns a single platform-owned shipping zone rule.

patch.description: Updates a platform-owned shipping zone rule's target zone and/or pricing method.

409.description: Platform shipping zone rule already exists for this zone

post.description: Marks a platform-owned shipping zone rule as active.
Marks a platform-owned shipping zone rule as inactive without deleting it.
Creates the platform category-based shipping rule for a product category. Only one platform category shipping rule can exist per category.

409.description: Platform category shipping rule already exists for this category

get.description: Returns all platform-owned category shipping rules.
Returns a single platform-owned category shipping rule.

patch.description: Updates a platform-owned category shipping rule's target category and/or pricing method.

409.description: Platform category shipping rule already exists for this category

post.description: Marks a platform-owned category shipping rule as active.
Marks a platform-owned category shipping rule as inactive without deleting it.
Creates a reusable product brand. Sellers can only reference brands created by admins.

409.description: Product brand name already exists

get.description: Returns all admin-managed product brands available for seller product creation.

patch.description: Updates the name or description of an admin-managed product brand.

409.description: Product brand name already exists

patch.description: Updates category metadata or deduction percentage used across the marketplace.

409.description: Product category name already exists

get.description: Returns all seller-submitted products that are still waiting for admin moderation.
Returns the full product details for one pending-review product, including category, brand reference, and uploaded images.

post.description: Marks a product as `approved`. Approved products are the ones intended to become visible to buyers in later buyer-facing catalog endpoints.

409.description: Product cannot be approved in the current state

post.description: Marks a product as `rejected`. Frontend should expect the rejection reason to come back through `review_note`.

409.description: Product cannot be rejected in the current state

200.description: Completed seller KYC submissions fetched successfully

example.message: Completed seller KYC submissions fetched successfully.

get.summary: Get a completed seller KYC submission

data.review_note: All required seller KYC documents were valid.

409.description: Seller KYC cannot be approved in the current state

post.description: Creates a buyer account in `not_verified` state and triggers email verification.

409.description: Buyer credentials already exist

get.description: Returns the authenticated buyer's current active cart with item details and computed totals. If the buyer does not yet have an active cart, the endpoint still succeeds and returns an empty cart state.

404.description: Buyer account not found or cart contains a product that no longer exists

post.summary: Add a product to buyer cart
post.description: Adds an approved product to the authenticated buyer's active cart. If the product is already in the active cart, the quantity is increased instead of creating a duplicate cart item.

409.description: Product is not approved, out of stock, or requested quantity exceeds stock

post.description: Calculates a shipping preview for the authenticated buyer's active cart using a saved billing address and a caller-supplied discounted subtotal. This endpoint does not create an order; it only returns the unified shipping total plus an internal per-segment breakdown from the shipping engine.

400.description: Validation failed or free-shipping coupon is invalid

404.description: Buyer account, billing address, shipping settings, active cart, or product not found

409.description: Cart is empty, delivery location is unsupported, shipping rules are unusable, product stock is insufficient, or currencies are mixed

delete.description: Removes all items from the authenticated buyer's active cart. This endpoint is idempotent, so it still succeeds when the buyer has no active cart or the cart is already empty.

patch.summary: Update product quantity in buyer cart
patch.description: Updates the quantity of a product already present in the authenticated buyer's active cart. The requested quantity must be greater than zero and cannot exceed the current approved product stock.

404.description: Buyer, active cart, cart item, or product not found

409.description: Product is not approved, out of stock, or requested quantity exceeds stock

delete.summary: Remove a product from buyer cart
delete.description: Removes the specified product from the authenticated buyer's active cart. The removal is scoped to the current buyer and only affects the active cart.

404.description: Buyer, active cart, or cart item not found

get.description: Returns the authenticated buyer's wishlist with product details for rendering the saved-products screen. Entries whose products no longer exist are skipped automatically.

post.summary: Add an approved product to buyer wishlist
post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated buyer's wishlist. The product must already be in `approved` status and duplicate wishlist entries are not allowed.

409.description: Product is not approved or already exists in wishlist

delete.summary: Remove a product from buyer wishlist
delete.description: Removes the specified product from the authenticated buyer's wishlist. The removal is scoped to the current buyer only.

404.description: Wishlist item or buyer not found

get.description: Returns all saved billing addresses belonging to the authenticated buyer. If the buyer has not saved any billing addresses yet, the endpoint still succeeds and returns an empty list.

post.description: Creates a saved billing address for the authenticated buyer. Buyers can have multiple billing addresses and this endpoint does not assign a default address.

delete.description: Deletes a saved billing address belonging to the authenticated buyer. The address is identified by its billing address id and removal is scoped to the current buyer only.

404.description: Buyer account or billing address not found

get.description: Returns approved and in-stock products only. Results are sorted newest first and support pagination plus optional category, brand, price, and search filters.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

get.summary: List approved products for a specific category
get.description: Returns approved and in-stock products for one category only. Results are sorted newest first and support pagination.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

get.summary: List approved products for a specific brand name
get.description: Returns approved and in-stock products for one brand only using the brand name. Results are sorted newest first and support pagination.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

get.description: Returns the full public detail for one approved product. Unlike the general listing endpoint, this can still return an approved product whose quantity is currently zero so the frontend can render an out-of-stock detail page.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

get.summary: Search approved products with live suggestions
get.description: Returns lightweight approved product suggestions while the frontend user is typing. Only approved and in-stock products are considered.

get.summary: Get the authenticated buyer or seller profile
get.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile. This endpoint is available only to buyer and seller accounts. Seller responses can include `account_type` and `kyc_status`.

403.description: Only buyer and seller accounts can access this endpoint

post.description: Creates a seller account in `not_verified` state, initializes seller KYC as `not_started`, and triggers email verification.

409.description: Seller credentials already exist

post.summary: Upload a product as a verified seller
post.description: Creates a seller product in `pending_review` state. This endpoint requires a seller token, a verified seller account, and approved seller KYC. `brand_id` is optional, `category_id` is required, and `sku` can be omitted because the backend can generate it.

201.description: Product uploaded successfully and is pending review

example.message: Product uploaded successfully and is pending review.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

400.description: Validation failed or product data is invalid

409.description: Seller account cannot upload products in the current state

get.summary: Get all products created by the authenticated seller
get.description: Returns all products created by the current seller, including review status and uploaded images. Frontend can use this for the seller dashboard, inventory view, and review feedback states.

data.name: Wireless Headset
data.description: Noise-cancelling wireless headset with long battery life.

get.summary: List available product categories for sellers
get.description: Returns the admin-managed category list that sellers should use when populating required `category_id` in product creation.

name.description: Admin-friendly display name for the free shipping rule.

coupon_code.description: Coupon code the buyer must enter to unlock free shipping.

name.description: Admin-friendly display name for the threshold rule.

minimum_order_subtotal.description: Discounted order subtotal that must be reached before free shipping applies automatically.

discounted_subtotal.description: Discounted cart subtotal supplied by the caller before shipping is added.

free_shipping_coupon_code.description: Optional free-shipping coupon code. When omitted, the engine still checks any active threshold-based free-shipping rule.
